metadata.description: Fine-grained RBAC (GRANT + DENY property/label scope) over an ENCRYPTED multi-tenant server (AES-256-GCM at rest): provision isolated tenant databases + roles/users/grants + DENY and assert the allow/deny/cross-tenant/DENY matrix over REST and Bolt, with ciphertext-on-disk, offline key rotation and encrypted-backup proofs.

notes: storage.bytes_fsynced is a proxy: the WAL on-disk byte count (every committed WAL byte is fsynced before commit acknowledgement), not a directly-observed fsync counter.

COMMITTED BASELINE (rmp #696): the fast-profile reference for the LOCAL regression gate. Only the DETERMINISTIC structural metrics — dataset size and the on-disk store/WAL footprint of a REAL TENANT database (databases/tenant_a/graphus.store, NOT the empty default 'graphus' db) — are gated (15% band) by sec_baseline_cmp; the machine-variant families (CPU, peak RSS, latency, throughput, and the single-run encryption-overhead timing) are NOT gated. Recorded on linux/x86_64 against the current build (DENY supported; the tenant store includes the DENY seed + RBAC WRITE probes).
